title.en: [DEMO] Importance survives the daily news cycle
title.zh: [演示] 重要性不随每日新闻周期消失

overview.en: Fictional local demonstration: an unresolved relief corridor from 13 days ago outranks a one-hour-old forum theme. The high-impact event stays on your attention agenda until you mark it read. Both examples and their bilingual analyses are hand-authored fixtures, not real news or AI research. No schedule is installed by this demo.
overview.zh: 本地虚构演示：13天前尚未解决的救援通道问题，排在一小时前的论坛配色更新之前。重大事件会保留在关注议程中，直至你标记已读。两个事件及其双语分析均为手工编写的样例，不是真实新闻或人工智能研究。此演示不会创建计划任务。

summary.en: [DEMO] In this fictional scenario, essential supplies remain blocked for 800,000 residents. The 13-day-old event stays important because the disruption is unresolved.
summary.zh: [演示] 在这个虚构情景中，80万居民仍无法获得必要物资。虽然事件已持续13天，未解决的中断使它仍然重要。

whyItMatters.en: Demo interpretation: an unresolved disruption to essential supplies has broader consequences than a cosmetic product update. This illustrates importance-based ranking; it is not a real crisis forecast.
whyItMatters.zh: 演示解读：必要物资持续中断的影响，比产品外观更新更广泛。此处演示按重要性排序，并非真实危机预测。

uncertainty.en: [DEMO] All names, numbers and URLs are synthetic. No real article was opened or verified. The reopening date is intentionally unspecified in the scenario.
uncertainty.zh: [演示] 名称、数字和网址均为虚构。没有访问或核查真实文章。情景刻意未指定恢复通行的日期。

watch.en: [DEMO] A material update would be a fictional reopening or a change in supply access. Merely loading this same example tomorrow must not create a new material update.
watch.zh: [演示] 实质性更新可为虚构通道恢复通行或物资获取发生变化。明天再次加载相同样例，不应制造新的实质性进展。

evidence.label: [DEMO] Reserved .example fixture URL; not a real report

summary.en: [DEMO] A fictional forum has added an optional color theme. It is newer than the corridor event, but its consequences are limited.
summary.zh: [演示] 一个虚构论坛新增了可选配色主题。它比救援通道事件更新，但影响范围有限。

whyItMatters.en: Demo interpretation: a minor usability preference should not displace a continuing high-impact event simply because it is newer. Its low score illustrates that distinction.
whyItMatters.zh: 演示解读：仅因消息较新，轻微的界面偏好变化不应取代仍在持续的重大事件。低分用于演示这一差别。

uncertainty.en: [DEMO] This announcement and its organization are invented. Its linked URL is reserved for examples and does not substantiate a real product release.
uncertainty.zh: [演示] 这则公告及其组织均为虚构。链接是保留的示例网址，不能作为真实产品发布的证据。

watch.en: [DEMO] No immediate follow-up is necessary in this scenario. A genuine change to user access or safety would require a new assessment, not just a new timestamp.
watch.zh: [演示] 此情景无需立即跟进。若用户访问或安全发生真正变化，应重新评估，而非仅更新日期。
